outcome: Natural Killer (NK) cell function (sustained reduction, diminished cytotoxic proteins: perforin, CD122, granzyme B)
Gene expression profiles of NK cells, monocytes, CD4+ T cells, CD8+ effector T cells, and antibody-producing B cells
cohort: Pregnant women, categorized into active SARS-CoV-2 infection, recovered from SARS-CoV-2, and healthy pregnancies, across two independent geographical cohorts.
finding: The study identified a sustained reduction and diminished cytotoxic function of Natural Killer (NK) cells, along with a rewired gene expression profile in multiple immune cell types, in pregnant women during active SARS-CoV-2 infection and after recovery compared to healthy pregnancies.
